pathways.headline: A starting point.
pathways.lede: Skilled trades grow through education, practice and experience. Explore common stages — and the learning that supports each one.

image.alt: Two students in hard hats kneeling to finish a freshly poured concrete pad on a training site

stages.title: Discover your direction.
stages.body: Start with interests, technical vocabulary, and an introduction to the work. Foundation learning can help you prepare for a training program or apprenticeship.
points: Explore different trades and work environments.
Build safety awareness, measurement, and technical reading skills.
Compare local training programs and entry requirements.

stages.title: Learn alongside experienced people.
stages.body: An apprentice learns through structured on-the-job experience and related instruction. Program design and entry requirements depend on the trade and provider.
points: Develop foundational skills under qualified supervision.
Connect classroom learning with workplace practice.
Document progress against your program's requirements.

stages.title: Develop independent competence.
stages.body: In trades that use this title, a journeyman has completed the required training and experience. Certification, licensing, and the scope of independent work vary.
points: Meet applicable qualification and continuing education requirements.
Support newer learners and deepen your specialty.

stages.title: Lead work. Grow your impact.
stages.body: Master-level practice and contracting are distinct paths that may overlap. Experienced tradespeople may lead complex work, supervise crews, or operate a business.
points: Develop project planning, leadership, and quality oversight.
Build business and customer communication skills.
Verify any advanced licensing or contractor requirements.

pathways.note: Titles and requirements vary by occupation, employer and jurisdiction. Not every trade follows this sequence. **VR learning alone does not confer apprenticeship status, licensure or qualification.**

levels.eyebrow: From your classroom to your future
levels.headline: Start with curiosity.
levels.lede: Very affordable immersive education can help bring trade exploration into high schools and strengthen technical learning in trade schools.

highSchool.title: See what you could become.
highSchool.body: Connect science, math and classroom learning to the work of technicians and craftspeople. Explore trade environments, learn the language of tools and systems, and discover interests worth pursuing.
points: Career exploration before choosing a training pathway
Teacher-led reflection and a next-step learning plan

image.alt: A student standing in the corridor of a technician training institute, framed certificates and awards on the wall behind him

tradeSchool.title: Turn interest into understanding.
tradeSchool.body: Connect immersive lessons to shop instruction. Revisit a process, explain a sequence, and identify where you need more guidance before demonstrating your learning with real equipment.

levels.note: Learning examples describe our educational vision. The original classroom artwork shows the youth-focused learning environment that inspires XVR Trade Skills.
